en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship named "S/S Trafik" alongside a breakwater or pier. In the foreground is a stone jetty leading out into the water, with rocks on one side. To the left stands a small lighthouse at the harbor entrance. The ship is moored beside the pier, and smaller sailboats are visible to the right. The image has scalloped postcard-style borders and a small printed serial number in the lower right.
